successors.name: Chu
successors.text: Zhongli, capital Zhongli (Fengyang, Anhui) in the Huai valley; the map caption says 'southeast'

ledger.x: 8th century BC: Zhongli arises in the Huai valley.
By 538 the state of Zhongli has ended in Chu's conquest; the year is a bound, not a date.

wars.name: Chu conquest of Zhongli
wars.outcome: Chu conquered Zhongli in the 6th century BC, held it by 538 BC and fortified it; the Wu king Liao took the city twenty years later (c.

certainty.note: No Zhongli boundary is on the page; soft throughout.
